name: Preload Bridge
description: Electron preload script using contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld to safely expose IPC methods to the renderer process. Bridges all 9 API namespaces: window controls, clipboard, terminal PTY, workspace persistence, shell, git, preferences, and filesystem. Wraps ipcRenderer.invoke (request/response) and ipcRenderer.send (fire-and-forget). Registers event listeners for terminal:data, terminal:exit, file:changed with unsubscribe functions.

bridge.versions: exposes { node, chrome, electron, app } from process.versions + sync IPC app:version
bridge.clipboard: readText via ipcRenderer.sendSync (sync, returns string), writeText via ipcRenderer.invoke
bridge.git: 17 git operations (remotes, branches, checkout, log, showTree, diff, currentBranch, stagedFiles, unstagedFiles, stagedDiff, unstagedDiff, commitBody, stage, unstage, commit, push, checkAhead)
